S3-CHEF-001_grid_layout_overflow.deep_root_cause_not_in_S3_proposal: Card height is HARDCODED `462px` in KdsOrderCard.vue:295. This is the REAL reason `grid-template-rows: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))` at KdsV2Grid.vue:356 does NOT shrink children: even when the grid cell shrinks (`minmax(0, 1fr)` allows it), the child <KdsOrderCard> refuses because of the inline `height: 462px`. Result: 2 rows × 462px = 924px guaranteed grid height, plus 16px gap + 32px padding (`KdsV2Grid.vue:357-358`) + 164px header chrome = 1136px > 1080px viewport. Overflow is DETERMINISTIC, not viewport-conditional.
